name: canal_palazzo
notes: A Venetian palace 14 m wide by 12 m deep, three storeys under a low hipped terracotta roof, rose-washed stucco with pale stone trim. Faces local -Z with a three-arch water gate along the ground floor, a loggia of pointed windows on a balcony above, a crenellated corbelled cornice and flared chimneys; rooms and a hall inside, carves nothing.
